outputs.headline: यह दावा गलत है: प्रधानमंत्री मोदी मुफ्त मोबाइल रिचार्ज नहीं दे रहे हैं।

outputs.what_is_true: सरकार मुफ्त मोबाइल रिचार्ज देने की कोई योजना नहीं चला रही है। ऐसे संदेश और वीडियो लोगों को धोखा देने के लिए एक घोटाले का हिस्सा हैं।

outputs.headline: SCAM: PM Modi is not giving free mobile recharge
outputs.summary: The claim that Prime Minister Modi is offering three months of free mobile recharge to all Indians is false and part of a scam.
outputs.what_post_claims: A post claims that Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians three months of free mobile recharge.
outputs.what_is_true: The government is not running any scheme to provide free mobile recharges. Messages and videos claiming this are fake and are part of a scam to defraud people.
evidence_against: The government's PIB Fact Check Unit stated that a viral video making this claim is AI-generated and fake.
BOOM fact-checked a similar video and found it to be edited.
Vishvas News and FACTLY have also debunked similar claims about free mobile recharge schemes.
outputs.sources_spoken: according to the PIB Fact Check Unit and BOOM
outputs.audio_script: A post claims that Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians three months of free mobile recharge. This claim is false. The government is not running any scheme to provide free mobile recharges, and messages or videos claiming this are fake and part of a scam. We are very sure about this. This information comes from the PIB Fact Check Unit, which stated that a viral video making this claim is AI-generated, and from BOOM, which found a similar video to be edited.
card_lines: SCAM: PM Modi is not giving free mobile recharge
This is a scam to defraud people.
